native_q_matrix.note: Reduced structures are in-memory OR partitions only.

fitted_bank_safety_export.policy: Exclude unfitted, nonpositive-loading, and extreme-loading criteria; never substitute synthetic parameters.

predeclared_reverse_item_exclusions.note: calibrate_mirt honors exclude_from_fit when present. The current InFoBench bank has no such flags, so unstable items are removed at the fitted-bank export gate rather than retroactively changing the frozen source Q-matrix.

efa.reason: With 52 persons and more than 2,000 binary criteria, an item-level EFA is underidentified; reduced structures are instead decided by disjoint-scenario OOS performance.

within_scenario_local_dependence.mitigation: Primary validation holds out whole scenarios, but the core criterion-level M2PL still assumes conditional independence.

infobench_specific_human_judge_audit.note: Qwen was selected on TutorBench; its agreement should also be audited on a stratified InFoBench sample before production claims. This does not alter the response matrix during the calibration study.
